semantic_models.name: ticket
semantic_models.description: One row per support ticket (mart_tickets), queue type/account name/assignee role denormalized.

measures.name: ticket_count
measures.expr: ticket_id

measures.name: ticket_active_day_count
measures.expr: cast(created_at as date)

measures.name: resolved_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_resolved then ticket_id end

measures.name: open_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_open then ticket_id end

measures.name: active_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_pending then ticket_id end

measures.name: closed_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_closed then ticket_id end

measures.name: pending_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_pending then ticket_id end

measures.name: reopened_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_reopened then ticket_id end

measures.name: high_priority_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when lower(priority) in ('high', 'urgent') then ticket_id end

measures.name: assigned_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when has_assignee then ticket_id end

measures.name: unassigned_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when not has_assignee and is_pending then ticket_id end

measures.name: tickets_with_resolver_count
measures.expr: case when has_resolver then ticket_id end

measures.name: tickets_without_resolver_count
measures.expr: case when not has_resolver then ticket_id end

measures.name: due_today_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_due_today then ticket_id end

measures.name: current_overdue_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_overdue then ticket_id end

measures.name: sla_at_risk_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_sla_at_risk then ticket_id end

measures.name: unanswered_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when not has_first_response then ticket_id end

measures.name: tickets_created_today_count
measures.expr: ticket_id

measures.name: tickets_last_7_days_count
measures.expr: ticket_id

measures.name: tickets_last_30_days_count
measures.expr: ticket_id

measures.name: days_since_last_ticket_val
measures.expr: extract(epoch from (now() - created_at)) / 86400.0

measures.name: breached_ticket_count
measures.expr: case when is_breached_proxy then ticket_id end

measures.name: resolution_hours_sum
measures.expr: resolution_hours

measures.name: resolved_ticket_count_for_avg
measures.expr: case when resolution_hours is not null then ticket_id end

measures.name: first_response_hours_sum
measures.expr: first_response_hours

measures.name: first_response_minutes_sum
measures.expr: first_response_minutes

measures.name: tickets_with_first_response_count
measures.expr: case when has_first_response then ticket_id end

measures.name: first_response_met_count
measures.expr: case when has_first_response and sla_first_response_hours is not null and first_response_hours <= sla_first_response_hours then ticket_id end

measures.name: tickets_with_first_response_sla_target_count
measures.expr: case when has_first_response and sla_first_response_hours is not null then ticket_id end

measures.name: resolution_sla_met_count
measures.expr: case when is_resolution_sla_met then ticket_id end

measures.name: tickets_with_resolution_sla_target_count
measures.expr: case when has_resolution_sla_target then ticket_id end

measures.name: resolution_hours_variance_sum
measures.expr: resolution_hours_variance

measures.name: tickets_with_sla_target_count
measures.expr: case when resolution_hours_variance is not null then ticket_id end

measures.name: overdue_hours_sum
measures.expr: overdue_hours

measures.name: open_ticket_age_days_sum
measures.expr: case when is_open then extract(epoch from (now() - created_at)) / 86400.0 end

measures.name: distinct_customers_served
measures.expr: customer_id

measures.name: distinct_accounts_served
measures.expr: account_id

measures.name: csat_score_sum
measures.expr: csat_score

measures.name: csat_rated_count
measures.expr: case when has_csat_score then ticket_id end

measures.name: csat_promoter_count
measures.expr: case when csat_score >= 4 then ticket_id end

measures.name: csat_neutral_count
measures.expr: case when csat_score = 3 then ticket_id end

measures.name: csat_detractor_count
measures.expr: case when csat_score <= 2 then ticket_id end

measures.name: average_overdue_hours_val
measures.expr: overdue_hours

semantic_models.name: ticket_note
semantic_models.description: One row per ticket note/reply (mart_ticket_notes), parent ticket priority/status/queue/assignee denormalized.

measures.name: note_count
measures.expr: ticket_note_id

measures.name: internal_note_count
measures.expr: case when is_internal_note then ticket_note_id end

measures.name: customer_visible_note_count
measures.expr: case when not is_internal_note then ticket_note_id end

semantic_models.name: agent_queue_member
semantic_models.description: One row per agent-to-queue membership (mart_agent_queue_members), queue name/type and agent name/role denormalized.

measures.name: queue_membership_count
measures.expr: queue_membership_id

measures.name: distinct_agents_in_queues_count
measures.expr: user_id

measures.name: distinct_queues_covered_count
measures.expr: queue_id

semantic_models.name: audit_event
semantic_models.description: One row per audit event (mart_audit_events), parent ticket priority/status/queue/assignee denormalized.

measures.name: audit_event_count
measures.expr: audit_event_id

measures.name: escalation_count
measures.expr: case when is_escalation_event then audit_event_id end

measures.name: assignment_change_count
measures.expr: case when is_assignment_event then audit_event_id end

measures.name: creation_event_count
measures.expr: case when is_creation_event then audit_event_id end

semantic_models.name: proactive_recommendation
semantic_models.description: One row per proactive AI recommendation (mart_proactive_recommendations), parent ticket priority/status/queue denormalized.

measures.name: recommendation_count
measures.expr: recommendation_id

measures.name: accepted_count
measures.expr: case when is_accepted then recommendation_id end

measures.name: dismissed_count
measures.expr: case when is_dismissed then recommendation_id end

measures.name: open_recommendation_count
measures.expr: case when is_open then recommendation_id end

semantic_models.name: proactive_approval
semantic_models.description: One row per proactive AI action approval (mart_proactive_approvals), parent ticket priority/status/queue denormalized.

measures.name: approval_count
measures.expr: approval_id

measures.name: approved_count
measures.expr: case when is_approved then approval_id end

measures.name: rejected_count
measures.expr: case when is_rejected then approval_id end

measures.name: pending_approval_count
measures.expr: case when is_pending then approval_id end

measures.name: decided_count
measures.expr: case when decision_hours is not null then approval_id end

measures.name: decision_hours_sum
measures.expr: decision_hours

semantic_models.name: kb_article
semantic_models.description: Knowledge base articles for the organization.

measures.name: kb_article_count
measures.expr: kb_article_id

measures.name: kb_published_article_count
measures.expr: case when is_published then kb_article_id end

measures.name: kb_views_sum
measures.expr: view_count

semantic_models.name: macro
semantic_models.description: Saved reply templates / macros for the organization.

measures.name: macro_count
measures.expr: macro_id

semantic_models.name: notification
semantic_models.description: In-app staff notifications for the organization.

measures.name: notification_count
measures.expr: notification_id

measures.name: unread_notification_count
measures.expr: case when not is_read then notification_id end

measures.name: outbound_email_count
measures.expr: outbound_email_id

measures.name: active_customer_count
measures.expr: case when is_active then customer_id end

measures.name: total_customer_count
measures.expr: customer_id

measures.name: active_agent_count
measures.expr: case when is_active and role = 'agent' then user_id end

measures.name: total_user_count
measures.expr: user_id

measures.name: agent_queue_count
measures.expr: queue_id

measures.name: queues_at_risk_count
measures.expr: case when is_at_risk then queue_id end

measures.name: proactive_audit_count
measures.expr: proactive_audit_id
